role: capture harness builder (no findings; files only)
notes: Source truth for desktop+mobile is the ACCEPTED_OBSERVATION screenshot from data/linear.app/site-observations/2026-08-25T19-23-01-716Z (copied, originals untouched).

CURRENT_SOURCE captures are live captures taken on the audit date; they are NOT truth for desktop/mobile and exist only to separate 'the site changed' from 'the clone is wrong'. For wide(1920) no accepted source exists, so CURRENT_SOURCE is the only source side.
Band composites are [source | clone | diff] with an 8px white gutter, downscaled to <=2400px total width. Band height is 900 CSS px (x deviceScaleFactor in device pixels).
Band filename score is the band changedRatio over the FULL band rect (rows past one side's end count as changed); metrics.json also carries changedRatioCommonOnly for every band.
Top-level metrics follow src/reconstruction-qa/screenshot-diff.ts exactly: never resize, composite over white, a pixel differs when any R/G/B channel differs by >= 1, overlap area only.

overview.png is a whole-page THUMBNAIL only: scaled to <=1600px total width AND <=4000px height, so on very tall pages the panels get narrow. The bands/ composites are the high-resolution evidence; read those to judge paint.

diff.png is full resolution over the common area: changed pixels red (green channel scaled by the delta magnitude, so a 1-unit antialiasing edge looks dark red and a wholly different block looks orange/yellow), identical pixels a dim grey ghost of the source.

Where the clone and the source have different heights, band composites fill the missing side with flat slate grey (rgb 90,90,110) — that colour means 'this side's page ended here', not 'the page is grey there'.
CURRENT_SOURCE at mobile(390) was not requested and was not captured; mobile has an ACCEPTED_OBSERVATION pair only.
Two files in this directory were NOT written by this harness and were left untouched: 28.5A-stage3-generation-measurements.json and stage5-template-vs-recon-pixel-diff.json.
